NAMECHEAP MAIL DNS RECORDS
Server IP: 80.241.223.82
DKIM selector: mail

IMPORTANT
- A and TXT records go under HOST RECORDS.
- MX records go under MAIL SETTINGS > Custom MX.
- Never enter an IP address as an MX value.
- Turn off Namecheap Email Forwarding.
- Delete all eforward*.registrar-servers.com MX records.
- Replace the old Namecheap forwarding SPF; never keep two SPF records.
- Paste every DKIM value as one line.

===============================================================================
DOMAIN: ifnotus.space
===============================================================================

HOST RECORDS

Type: A Record
Host: mail
Value: 80.241.223.82
TTL: Automatic

Type: TXT Record
Host: @
Value: v=spf1 ip4:80.241.223.82 a:mail.ifnotus.space ~all
TTL: Automatic

Type: TXT Record
Host: mail._domainkey
Value: v=DKIM1; h=sha256; k=rsa; 
TTL: Automatic

Type: TXT Record
Host: _dmarc
Value: v=DMARC1; p=none; rua=mailto:postmaster@ifnotus.space
TTL: Automatic

MAIL SETTINGS > CUSTOM MX

Type: MX Record
Host: @
Value: mail.ifnotus.space.
Priority: 10
TTL: Automatic
